execution: Shadow paper model only: newly completed public 1m opens plus frozen cost assumptions, stop-first ambiguity, next-minute modeled availability. Never actual fills, book quotes, account commissions or exchange orders.
start: Next UTC minute after registration. Flat sleeves. First decision at a future UTC hour; no old setups. Uses retained live SMA-seeded EMA/Wilder ATR history, which differs from the historical replay origin.
funding: Public actual settled rate and associated mark; enforce the current published nextFundingTime before processing due minutes. Missing settlement blocks, never treated as zero. Failure beyond observation grace freezes the run with unresolved open positions.
recovery: Durable atomic minute/state/cursor transaction. Exact contiguous-minute recovery only within grace. No retrospective entries after an observation gap; freeze permanently, retain evidence and unresolved positions. Changed source, filters, code or contracts freeze; restart does not reset or silently resume a frozen sample.
evaluation: At least 90 continuous calendar days and 100 closed trades per policy before assessment; insufficient sample remains inconclusive. Inspect all policies, costs, drawdown, mean R and uncertainty; no automatic winner, promotion or profitability guarantee. Frozen runs fail the continuity gate.
observation: Observe completed minutes only after 15 seconds of exchange-clock settling. Prior v1 sample froze on a genuine early REST candle revision and remains separately preserved. Later corrections still freeze, never overwrite.
